## Summary
Describe the feature or glitch filter you would like to see.

## Target scope
- [ ] `png-glitch` (core PNG library)
- [ ] `webp-glitch` (core WebP library)
- [ ] `glitch-context` (high-level filter pipeline / YAML config)
- [ ] `png-glitch-cli` (CLI flags / batch processing)

## Proposed CLI / API design
If applicable, show how the flag, `-f` filter spec, YAML config, or Rust API would look:
```sh
png-glitch input.png -f my-filter:magnitude=0.2
```

## Additional context
Add any visual references, algorithms, or examples.
